$comment: Fleet at birth per NG-11 §2i (CEO 2026-08-29). Nothing fake, ever (§2h): every slot below is either record-holding (a real maker × jurisdiction pair with a real signed RCO from a real rule set) or prefab class (real signed identity, real slot, real registry record, real routing job — declares class and rail, names the issuer registry, answers every task CPG-451 with the two doors; its card names no maker, jurisdiction or record). No slot is empty, unassigned or demo.

record_holding.pairing_rule: one slot = one maker × jurisdiction pair; a maker appearing in k jurisdictions holds k slots
record_holding.selection_rule: the first 1,000 maker × jurisdiction pairs the CPG Knowledge Graph resolves: GSC-served BPC makers first, then by market coverage

prefab_gsc_class.count_ruling: CEO 2026-08-29: block = 1,000. Fleet at birth = 3,050 (1,000 record-holding + 1,000 prefab GSC-class + 1,000 prefab partner-class + 49 jurisdiction doors + 1 door).

record_holding.rule: zero record-holders until a consortium-admitted issuer signs

jurisdiction_doors.source: the SM-ECO-10060 member registry (50 canonical strings minus the SM namespace anchor) — enum generated from the signed registry at build; the United Kingdom member code is UK (permanent GB=UK rule)
jurisdiction_doors.each_holds: its real rule set (rule-set.schema.json), versioned and signed

index_json.rule: the two counts are reported separately and both enter the number set of record

growth_rule: a prefab slot becomes record-holding only by a superseding registry record when a real signed RCO exists for a real pair — never by editing the slot in place; exhausted blocks grow only by CEO order; slots are never deleted, a retired pairing is superseded and retained
addressing: AS BUILT (2026-08-29, per the build order's slot ranges): slot agents are path agents under their rail root - card at https://<rail>/<slot>/.well-known/agent-card.json, receiver at https://<rail>/<slot>/a2a - the estate's fleet-root pattern; the v1.2 wildcard-hostname line was superseded by the build order's deployed shape
forwarding_batch: rco-a2a.com/.org and rcoa2a.ai → rco-a2a.ai; rco-a2a.io serves as the machine twin; rails' .com/.org/.io → their .ai; rco-10060.ai and the regulatorycomplianceobject/regulatory-compliance-object names → rco-10060.org — registrar-of-record table attached at build (verify-at-build, defect row 37)
